title: WaterSound 87 Salt Box Lane

normalized_matching_profile.name: WaterSound 87 Salt Box Lane
normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- 5-minute walk or a 1-minute bike ride from the beach - 4 adult bikes- 4-seater golf cart - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutupon every checkout- This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: 87 Salt Box Lane is a beautiful home in a sought-after WaterSound neighborhood, making this an unforgettable vacation location! This stately 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home, will be perfect for your vacation get-a-way! With its bright and airy rooms and natural surroundings, this will give you a piece of paradise! The home is surrounded by green space on three sides, giving it an exclusive, relaxed, and private atmosphere. When entering the home, you will be welcomed by the beautiful decor, warm tones, and the comfortable furnishings in the spacious great room. You will also be able to enjoy meals from the home's fantastic kitchen. There, you will experience the high-end appliances, marble countertops, stunning cabinetry, and the gigantic breakfast bar. This kitchen has all of the items needed to prepare that wonderful meal! The relaxing living room, well-appointed dining room, and incredible kitchen are all included in this open floor plan for everyone to enjoy after a fun-filled day at the beach. What a perfect end to a perfect day! On the first floor, you will find the primary king bedroom, and connecting, spa-like primary bathroom that has a double vanity, soaker tub, and a glass shower. -On the second floor, you will find a comfortable queen bedroom with a connecting bathroom with a single vanity, a tub, and shower. There is also another queen bedroom on this floor with a connecting bathroom that has a single vanity and a shower. Lastly, there is a bedroom with two double beds and a TV with a connecting bathroom that has a single vanity and a tub and shower combination. All of the bedrooms have flat-screen TV's for additional enjoyment for the entire family. This house has ample indoor and outdoor space, making for a memorable vacation! This gorgeous WaterSound home is simply stunning and gives you the serenity you have been craving, and it is all here at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Bathroom With Shower/TubSECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Bathroom With Tub/Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Bathroom With Shower- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Bathroom With Tub/Shower ComboIMPORTANT INFORMATION *HOA regulations do not allow for guest golf cart rentals. Additionally, bringing your own golf cart onto the property is prohibited.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.* To ensure a comfortable stay for all guests, pets are not permitted on the property. Please note that any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.*Garage is not for guest use.
